clarifications: Task scope is strictly 4 budget-counted files.
Normal G-031 limit of 5 files is observed with zero overrides.
G-041 semantic authorization is TRUE (explicit human owner decision).
G-042 guardrails authorization is FALSE (zero guardrails modified).

Human Semantic Decision 1: If a character begins transitioning from COVERED toward EXPOSED while RELOADING, reload is cancelled immediately, Weapon Action immediately becomes READY, incomplete reload progress is discarded, and zero ammunition is granted.

Human Semantic Decision 2: If a character receives STUN while RELOADING, reload is cancelled immediately, Weapon Action immediately becomes READY, incomplete reload progress is discarded, and zero ammunition is granted.

Authority boundary: READY after cancellation means strictly that the weapon is no longer FIRING or RELOADING. READY does NOT imply firing permission, ammunition availability, global actionability, absence of STUN, or satisfaction of posture prerequisites.
GAP-GS-003 is NOT resolved except for this exact cancellation target-state clarification; reload duration, manual reload, and reserve-ammo rules remain unresolved.
No fourth WeaponAction value is added.
No Domain implementation code or test code is changed in this Semantic Layer task.
